pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with soft curvilinear edges. Spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank and reduces significantly in scale toward the hindquarters and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light cream-colored pathways. The topology is dominated by tri-node junctions. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank but exhibits slight narrowing as it approaches the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck and shoulder transition, representing the mane hair against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes with distinct cranial protrusions perched directly on the dorsal ridge and upper flank, causing localized occlusion of the pelage pattern.
